text:
rachel: Heads-up: several EU customers reported duplicate billing spikes correlated with WS sessions showing 'halfclose' in proxy logs. Not seeing data plane errors otherwise.
mike: Oof. Which proxy? edge-proxy-v2?
rachel: Yep edge-proxy-v2 behind lb-eu. Example conn_id: conn=6842f. Logs: 'upstream halfclose (204) -> client reconnect' repeatedly.
pooja: Do we emit a billing event on connection open + resume? If so a quick reconnect loop could double-charge.
infra-bot: BillingEvent: tenant=t-88 conn_open trace=aa11 timestamp=1744449951
sre: Clients are configured with immediate reconnect on WS close (no jitter), which can cause fast open/close. Should be exponential backoff.
mike: Historically we counted tokens on open and on stream data receipts. The open-sided accounting was introduced for SSE parity but problematic on noisy halfclose.
pooja: We need guardrails: (1) Ignore billing for opens that follow a halfclose from proxy within Xs, or (2) make the proxy return a definitive 4xx/5xx instead of 204 halfclose where applicable.
console-dev: UX idea: surface a "transient halfclose" annotation in the console route timeline so support sees the proxy-side halfclose flapping. Add per-tenant recent-halfclose count.
rachel: Good. Mitigation plan: add server-side debounce: if last_close.reason == 'halfclose' && now - last_close < 10s then mark open as 'resumed' and don't emit open-billing. PoC config: ```billing_open_debounce_ms: 10000```
mike: Works but we should be careful with true reconnects after long outage. Maybe tie to session_id reuse or opaque resume token.
pooja: Also add client-side doc: encourage exponential backoff with jitter. Small patch in js-sdk: default backoff base=500ms, max=10000ms, jitter=true. PR: https://git.company/sdk-js/pull/900
sre: Immediate short-term: disable open-side billing for route=/v1/ws-stream for 30m while we roll the debounce. Need an emergency flag?
rachel: Feature flag exists: billing_route_overrides. I'll flip for eu-shard-2.
infra-bot: FLAG_CHANGE: billing_route_overrides:/v1/ws-stream disabled at 1744450050 by rachel
console-dev: I'll add a temporary console banner: "billing debug mode: ws open-side billing disabled (canary)" and add a small panel showing connection open vs data tokens.
mike: Long-term: prefer attribution based on first data tokens rather than open event. But that affects latency billing invariants; will need product signoff.
pooja: Also add telemetry: metric 'proxy.halfclose.count' tagged by tenant and 'billing.open_ignored' to show impact.
rachel: Action items: (A) I'll flip flag on eu-shard-2 (done). (B) pooja to update js-sdk PR. (C) mike to design first-data billing proto. (D) console-dev to add banner + panel. (E) infra to add billing_open_debounce toggle.
sre: Monitoring: watch tenant t-88 spike. If still anomalous after 15m we revert.
infra-bot: NOTE: metric sampling increased for route /v1/ws-stream for 20m.
rachel: Flip succeeded, early signal: t-88 duplicate billing events down 90%. Leaving canary for 25m.
console-dev: Banner and halfclose panel deployed to canary console.
mike: Filing RFC for moving to data-first billing: https://git.company/rfcs/2026/data-first-billing.md
pooja: Thanks all. We'll follow up with a postmortem if this regresses. :slightly_smiling_face:
